title: Histological and radiological evaluation of sintered and non-sintered deproteinized bovine bone substitute materials in sinus augmentation procedures. A prospective, randomized-controlled, clinical multicenter study.*
authors: Fienitz T, Moses O, Klemm C, Happe A, Ferrari D, Kreppel M, Ormi aner Z, Gal M, Rothamel D. Clinical Oral Investigations 2017; 21(3):787-794. [Epub 2016].
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both xenogeneic bone substitute materials showed comparable results regarding new bone formation and radiologic al height changes in external sinus grafting procedures” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
